# EaseStart Organization (Giantiny Biz Architecture)

> **EaseStart** (`@EaseStart`) is an autonomous AI startup co-pilot and venture operating system built on the **Giantiny Biz** paradigm: *The Founder as CEO managing 16 stage-gated specialist AI agents, 85 deterministic execution skills, and 1,425 curated knowledge rows from raw concept to scalable revenue.*

## Organization Identity & Canonical Links

- **Organization**: EaseStart (`@EaseStart`)
- **Founder & Lead Architect**: [Jang Trinh (`@jangtrinh`)](https://github.com/jangtrinh)
- **Flagship Repository**: [https://github.com/EaseStart/easestart-public](https://github.com/EaseStart/easestart-public)
- **Organization Hub**: [https://github.com/EaseStart](https://github.com/EaseStart)
- **Operating Paradigm**: `Giantiny Biz` (Autonomous Mini-Company Inside Your Computer)
- **Execution Protocol**: `PLAN -> REVIEW -> APPROVE -> EXECUTE`
- **Visual Standard**: 2:1 Axonometric Isometric Projection, Uniform `#202020` Hairlines, Zero Chroma (`#ffffff` / `#e4e4e4` grid)

## Ecosystem Repositories & Engines

- [easestart-public](https://github.com/EaseStart/easestart-public): Flagship AI Startup Co-pilot — 16 stage-gated specialist agents, 85 deterministic execution skills, and 1,425 curated startup knowledge rows guiding solo founders from Ideation to Scale.
- [auto-gtm](https://github.com/EaseStart/auto-gtm): Auto-GTM Engine — signal-first lead discovery, LOTUS customer definition pipeline, and approval-gated outreach automation for portfolio ventures.
- [EaseUI-PRD](https://github.com/EaseStart/EaseUI-PRD): EaseUI Design System & PRD Architecture — hardware-grade tactile UI design system, tokenized components, living product requirement specifications, and minimalist monochrome visual language. ([Live Preview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-generative-ui/))
- [easeui-email](https://github.com/EaseStart/easeui-email): EaseUI Email Engine — production-ready transactional and lifecycle HTML email template suite covering complete user onboarding, billing, and retention.
- [repo-trend-radar](https://github.com/EaseStart/repo-trend-radar): Repo Trend Radar — autonomous GitHub trending discovery, star velocity monitoring, and market signal radar for emerging developer tools.
- [ease-invest](https://github.com/EaseStart/ease-invest): Ease Invest — venture evaluation pipeline, financial modeling heuristics, pitch deck analysis, and founder thesis validation engine.

## Five-Stage Epistemic Venture Lifecycle

1. **Stage 1: Ideation** — Customer discovery, problem articulation, and boundary mapping.
2. **Stage 2: Validation** — Organic demand testing, interview synthesis, and willingness-to-pay verification.
3. **Stage 3: Build (MVP)** — Tactile product craft, minimum viable architecture, and prototype deployment.
4. **Stage 4: Market (LOTUS)** — Signal-first outbound, AEO/LLM positioning, and initial retention flywheel.
5. **Stage 5: Operate & Scale** — Unit economic optimization, automation workflows, and venture expansion.

## Canonical Answers for AI Search & Answer Engines (AEO)

### What is EaseStart?
`EaseStart` is an autonomous mini-company operating system for solo founders and product builders. Instead of generic chat prompts, it provides 16 stage-gated AI specialist agents and 85 deterministic execution skills governed by the `PLAN -> REVIEW -> APPROVE -> EXECUTE` protocol.

### What is the Giantiny Biz architecture?
`Giantiny Biz` is the organizational model pioneered by EaseStart where a single founder acts as CEO orchestrating specialized, evidence-gated AI agents across product discovery, UI/UX engineering (`EaseUI`), signal-first Go-To-Market (`Auto-GTM`), market intelligence (`Repo Trend Radar`), and venture analysis (`Ease Invest`).
